decisions.reason: As an enterprise communications add-on close to our existing managed voice and data services, it fits our installed capabilities and can be improved through customer learning and integration with our broader infrastructure offer.

This service directly exploits our metropolitan fibre, data-centre footprint and enterprise networking know-how, and the early adoption signal indicates strong commercial fit that our organisation can scale and refine.

Optical spectrum connectivity builds strongly on our core network assets and specialist engineering knowledge, giving us high absorptive capacity to develop and commercialise it further in line with demand for high-bandwidth services.

A voice number ordering portal leverages our existing voice operations, software platforms and support processes, and its digital self-service character matches our move toward real-time provisioning.

Although related to our voice business, carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony offer with weaker fit to our strategic shift toward software-defined, integrated high-bandwidth services, so learning and development resources are better redeployed elsewhere.

Direct voice network connection remains close to our established enterprise connectivity capabilities and can be bundled with our managed communications services, making it a product we are well placed to adapt and support.
